levels.surface: عبد الله بن إبراهيم بن علي بن عبد الله بن جعفر بن أبي طالب

notes: «عنه» opens the report and refers to the previous report's teacher; previous_reports (prev1 to prev10) write no chain and prev11 writes a chain of several names, so how much is taken over is not settled: written as back_reference, not inherited
«عن أبي إبراهيم عليه السلام» is inside the chain after «عن»: narrator; his words («إني أؤخذ في هذه السنة») are the saying
«في حديث طويل» is a gloss on the report's length, left out
